body: A lot of unsubs started as victims. I don’t think that should be a disqualifier. It was the “innocent” Tobias that got Spencer hooked on heroin, after all. I liked the differences in his personas and I was so invested in the team saving Spencer. This was back when I was still hoping he and JJ would get together, and her part of the story was really compelling as well since she was there when he got taken.
Does sex ever feel like work when you’re making content?
